scenarios.name: spot_mac01_drec
scenarios.subject: Toad Town mac_01, Mario placed at pos 0 0 200 (warp entry 0), cold det start with the drec switch: the draw records of frames 200 and 201 go to shots/drec.txt.
scenarios.proves: HOSTCORE2: the draw record text of the mac_01 frames 200 and 201 is a function of the build (det), so a base and a head build give a byte-equal drec.txt when no draw changes.
scenarios.debug: warp=mac_01:0 pos=0:0:200 prof=4 loglevel=debug det drec=200:2
scenarios.reason: HOSTCORE2: spot_mac01_det with drec=200:2 in place of the shots. Cold start (as spot_mac01_det, 12 to 16 s to the first marker), cap 35 s, deadline 30 s. The drec log line is the until.
